protocol: Three S&P 500 year-end closes. Fixed [0,10000) range, six ten-way greedy levels down to .01 points. Single-call 100-bin control at width 100. Two orders and two repeats, English prompts. No prompt revision mid-run. Verified closing_level_index_points added to state; questions unchanged from closed-book run.
limits: Historical recall, not forecasting or known training-set membership. Closed-book request but server internals unknown. Three dates only; greedy refinement can add false precision.
